As Twelve South's brand-new Airfly Drive wireless CarPlay adapter hits the market at $40, Amazon has once again refreshed its early autumn Prime Day early-bird deals, rolling out a host of new discounts. Today's 9to5Toys lunch headlines include up to $150 off the M5 MacBook Air, a continuing $500 discount on the M5 Pro 2TB model, and an all-time low on a single 2026 Apple AirTag 2 on Amazon. Also featured: $50 off the Sharge metal 300W smart display power bank, multiple all-time lows on Belkin 25W MagSafe charging stands, and official autumn Prime Day deals on Eve Matter/HomeKit outlets, light switches, power strips and more, starting from $32. Read on for details.

Twelve South launches brand-new Airfly Drive wireless CarPlay and Android Auto adapter

After rolling out a series of early-autumn Prime Day early-bird deals, Twelve South is set to officially unveil the new Airfly Drive today. The latest addition to the Airfly lineup is a CarPlay and Android Auto adapter, now on sale at $39.99. The market is flooded with similar products from no-name brands (usually far less well-designed than this one), but Twelve South has finally joined the fray.

Full vehicle compatibility list for the new Twelve South Airfly Drive CarPlay and Android Auto adapter

M5 MacBook Air models see up to $150 off in early-autumn Prime Day deals

Aside from a handful of flash-gone Apple official refurb deals, Amazon's early-autumn Prime Day sale is offering the best discounts on the current M5 MacBook Air, with select models now up to $150 off.

Three configurations are worth noting right now — the base model, the 24GB 15-inch version, and this mid-tier 13-inch model. If you must buy another configuration, we'd recommend holding off for now:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 (was $1,599)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,399 (was $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,849 (was $1,999)

The two upgraded configurations are $150 off, while the 15-inch base model is $100 off. At this stage, these are the target discounts — the base model rarely sees deals, so a $100 discount is already quite good; for the upgraded configurations, wait until they hit $150 off before pulling the trigger.

These deals can also count as one of the best MacBook offers in recent months — the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB storage is $500 off its original price.

This $500-off M5 Pro MacBook Pro may be the standout early-autumn Prime Day deal

Amazon's early-autumn Prime Day sale is live with thousands of markdowns, but one Apple discount in particular is worth grabbing before it sells out. It's hard to predict what next week's Prime Day will hold for the MacBook Pro lineup, but right now you can lock in this M5 Pro 2TB model with a hefty $500 discount.

Available in Space Black and Silver, Amazon is now selling the 14-inch MN5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM, 2TB storage, and upgraded 18/20-core internals for $2,699 with free shipping.

You can still grab a single 2026 Apple AirTag 2 at an all-time low on Amazon

We've covered the four-pack discounts multiple times, but for users who don't need four, Amazon's early-autumn Prime Day sale is still offering the brand-new Apple 2026 AirTag 2 at its lowest price ever.

Although the discount isn't huge — Prime members get free shipping at $24 — bear in mind this is a 2026 Apple product that only retails for $29 to begin with.

  • AirTag 2: $24 (was $29) — matches all-time low

The four-pack is still on sale at $89, or $22.50 per tag, but in recent months we've seen prices drop another $9 lower, and that could resurface before the early-autumn Prime Day kicks off.

The cheapest 2026 Studio Display configuration is now up to $300 off at Apple's refurbished store

As Amazon's early-autumn Prime Day sale rolls on, Apple's official certified refurbished store is offering notable discounts on the cheapest 2026 Apple Studio Display — $240 off the tilt-adjustable stand version, and $300 off the tilt- and height-adjustable stand version.

Apple's refurbished store has the 2026 Apple Studio Display with tilt-adjustable stand back in stock for $1,359 with free shipping. Originally $1,599, it's $240 off; Amazon currently lists it at $1,550, and its lowest price has only ever dipped to $1,484.

The 2026 model with tilt- and height-adjustable stand is now shipping for $1,699 with free delivery. Originally $1,999, that's a real $300 off, well below Amazon's current $1,984; even the lowest Amazon price for a new unit has only been $1,886.

Eve's official autumn Prime Day deals are live: up to 38% off Matter/HomeKit switches, outlets, power strips and more, starting from $30

Although Prime Big Deal Days doesn't officially kick off until next week, Eve has informed 9to5Toys that its official autumn Prime Day deals are live on Amazon starting today. A wide range of the brand's well-regarded HomeKit- and Matter-compatible smart home products are now available at Prime Big Deal Days pricing, with up to 38% off. Head to the brand's official Amazon store to shop — full details below.

Eve runs promotions year-round, but it's only during major sales events like this that prices drop significantly. The brand's extensive lineup of multi-platform, Matter-compatible products — from power strips, smart outlets, light switches, water leak detectors, and motion sensors to Motionblinds smart window coverings — is now available at autumn Prime Day pricing.

Brand-new Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K is half-price, with other models from $16

This big launch discount joins the rest of the early-autumn Prime Day markdowns on Fire TV Sticks and streaming devices, with prices starting from $16.

Brand-new 2026 Kindle lineup

Amazon is also rolling out a fairly major refresh of the 2026 Kindle lineup, with new versions of the standard Kindle, Paperwhite, and Colorsoft arriving simultaneously. The new models feature flush displays, slimmer designs, and a range of upgrades depending on the version — including faster performance, higher-contrast screens, and a new aluminum back option. Updated pricing starts from $149.99 with free shipping for the standard Kindle, with the Paperwhite and Colorsoft from $199.99 and $289.99 respectively. Amazon has also added a number of new accessories, including the Kindle Click Bluetooth page-turn remote.
